reviews.text: Not the tidiest place in town, but he does good work at a very fair price. Would recommend for any of your small projects.
reviews.author: Dave B.

reviews.text: Great service and great value. Galen did a great job repairing the frame on our truck. Thank you so much for your expertise and skills.
reviews.author: Jeff G.

reviews.text: I've used Lamar's welding and repair services for many years, where replacement is not an option — mostly little stuff like repairing broken piano pedals, but also a few big jobs like the I-beams on my truck bed.
reviews.author: Michael S.
